svg.title: Three-way warehouse T-junction: six robots
svg.desc: A three-cell-wide T-junction with two robots per approach and a separate parking bay for each destination.

g.text: 6 robots · 2 per approach · straight and turning routes · private parking
Arrows show intended travel direction. All robots initially face north.
